limits: Small serial unprofiled performance screens, not precise general speed guarantees. Four observations per game and selection; eight for broad Snakes after its initial pairs disagreed.
All timing runs use deterministic game input and exact virtual/instruction/presentation windows. Warmup is retained separately. No samples were discarded.
Game replay and module-inspection timings overlapped correctness work and are excluded from throughput comparisons.
The broader compiler run was stopped after affected tests, during unrelated IR tests. Its diagnostic-counter failure was fixed and retested separately; this is not a complete suite pass.
Neither selection establishes a universal speedup. Policy 17 was initially opt-in and was subsequently adopted as the browser default with the measured tradeoff accepted.
Captured module byte size is not V8 machine-code size and does not prove instruction-level sampled cost.
